title: The Max-Level Player's 100th Regression
altTitles: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player
The 100th Regression of a Max-Level Player
カンストプレイヤーの100回目の回帰
La regresión 100 del jugador de nivel máximo
description: Earth is suddenly turned into a brutal 20-round death game in which everyone between the ages of 15 and 29 must participate. Ryu Min reaches the final round alone after surviving the game 99 times, only to be killed because the final stage requires a party of at least five players. Now on his 100th and final regression, he uses everything he learned from his previous 99 lives to build the perfect team and finally clear the game.
author: King Soda / Yeoun / YAEM
